'''Corruptor Zero''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] that commanded the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Army/Legends|armies]] of the [[Dread Masters]] at the [[Dread Fortress]] on [[Oricon]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Dread War]], Corruptor Zero was [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] while trying to repel invading forces.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Corruptor Zero appears as the fourth boss in the Operation "The Dread Fortress," which was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'' in Game Update 2.4.<ref name="TOR" />
